mechanism.claim: At the actual US equity cash close, remove BTC's causally estimated SPY beta from the just-completed inter-close BTC return. An extreme idiosyncratic BTC residual during high realized variation reflects crypto-specific overshoot rather than broad risk repricing and should reverse over the next twelve hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the current equity-adjusted BTC residual
mechanism.why_distinct: BSCBR trades changes in a fitted DCC correlation using a published safe-haven sign. HVEABRR uses a rolling prior-only linear beta and the current return residual magnitude. Equity-volatility candidates use VIX-family levels. No BSCBR event, threshold, clock subset, or control is reused.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse actual NYSE closes with DST, holidays, early closes and joint residual/variation tails are absent from Gross9

features.session: hash-bound official NYSE schedule and split/dividend-aware SPY daily source already frozen by BSCBR
features.spy_return: log((split-normalized close plus effective-date cash dividend)/previous session split-normalized close)
features.btc_return: log(BTC completed-hour close at current actual SPY close / completed-hour close at prior actual SPY close)
features.beta: population covariance(BTC,SPY)/population variance(SPY) over at most 60 strictly prior valid paired sessions, minimum 40; current excluded; positive finite SPY variance required
features.residual_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs residual over at most 90 prior valid residuals, minimum 60; current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact 5m close-to-close BTC returns over 24 hours ending at cash close)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 prior valid SPY sessions, minimum 60; current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.availability: five minutes after actual SPY cash close and matched completed BTC bar; no imputation

clock.entry: actual SPY cash close+10m BTCUSDT open
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

definitions.no_variation_gate: residual-tail reversal without BTC variation rank
definitions.raw_btc_return_reversal: primary eligibility clock, negative BTC-return sign
definitions.one_session_stale_beta: current returns with beta estimated ending one additional session earlier

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent equity-adjusted idiosyncratic overshoot mechanism under high BTC variation

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no asset, beta, residual, rank, side, clock, delay, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
